golden_issues.problem: key_fact '30.00' is stated in the question itself ('petrol 30 ringgit'), so a system can 'match' it without reading any receipt; the only discriminating fact is 11.54 litres. Same defect on rcpt-b-03-full.

key_fact '100.00' is given in the question ('that RM100 fill-up'), so the fully correct answer '40.49' scores only partial for failing to restate a number the asker supplied. Same defect on rcpt-d-02-typed.

Comparison item: key_facts list only the two amounts (7.95, 6.35) and omit the discriminator ('the December one') that the question actually asks for, so a correct 'Dec' answer scores zero key facts. Same on rcpt-a-09-full.
Comparison item: key_facts are only 30.70 / 30.50; the discriminator 'AEON Shah Alam' is absent from key_facts, so naming the right trip scores zero. Same on rcpt-e-09-full.

Comparison item whose key_facts (56.00, 26.00, 10/07/2017) include the date but not an explicit 'which visit' discriminator string, making partial credit for a correct choice-only answer inconsistent with rcpt-d-10 (where 'AA PHARMACY' is a key fact). Same on rcpt-b-10-full.

Phrased as a yes/no question ('Do I have a receipt from Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf?'), so the correct decline is the word 'No' — a non-empty answer. Any not_found scorer keyed on the structured not_found flag will mislabel it false_answer. Same on rcpt-nf-07-full ('Is there anything from Platinum Racking…?').

Enumeration golds (count of 5 Wan Sheng receipts) are unanswerable under this run's top-k of 3: no configuration of the retrieved set can expose five files. The item measures the retrieval budget, not the reader. Same on rcpt-en-01-full, rcpt-en-02-*, rcpt-en-03-*.
